question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

Common sense, uncontrovursial ideas tend to diminish when attention has moved elsewhere.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"uncontrovursial"** is incorrectly spelt and should be **"uncontroversial".**
 
• **Meaning:** Not likely to cause disagreement or argument. (विवादास्पद नहीं)
 
 
• **Example: **The proposal was uncontroversial and received unanimous support.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sense** (संवेदना): The ability to perceive stimuli; a feeling or perception.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a good sense of humor.
 
 
 
• **Attention** (ध्यान): Notice taken of someone or something; the regarding of someone or something as interesting or important.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher called for the students' attention.
 
 
 
• **Diminish** (कम करना): To make or become less.
 
 
• **Example:** His influence in the company has diminished over time.
 
 

3c:T4af,
The correct answer is: Option 3</
